title: Junk.
text:
Junk.. Absolute garbage. I must leave a negative review. I’ve seen better
silk flowers in a dollar store.
To add to the insult, I have to pay to have a return label mailed.
Do not waste your money.

product_metadata.title: OakRidge Silk Begonia Bush – Artificial Flowers Outdoor Décor – Coral, 10” Long
features: Realistic Beauty – Begonia bush is so lush and lifelike, it will keep your neighbors guessing! Plant these silk florals in a pot or right in the ground for natural appeal surrounding your home

Artfully Constructed – These brilliant coral begonias with lush green leaves offer instant beauty and natural-looking texture that can be enjoyed year-round; group several together for an even fuller appearance

Versatile Décor – Designed for use both indoor and out, these lifelike begonias lend gorgeous charm to your front porch, walkway, patio, garden and home; faux flowers are perfect for everyday décor, birthdays, holidays, weddings, memorial sites, DIY projects and more

Maintenance Free – Enjoy the long-lasting beauty of these lifelike begonias without having to worry about sunlight, watering, pruning or other maintenance; these faux floral accents are forever-in-bloom wherever you choose to display them
Product Details – Faux floral bush is crafted of silky polyester, plastic and wire; each measures 10 inches long
description: Beautifully blooming in sunshine or shade, this silk begonia bush by OakRidgeTM requires no work or wateringoever With full, realistic flowers boasting natural color variations, each lifelike faux plant features lush, hearty leaves. (Weive shown 3 bushes; pot not included.) Polyester, plastic, wire. 10" long.
